description.value:
A vault that opened its doors a generation or two early, or never fully sealed to begin with — more comfortable in the sun than most Vaultborn, and it shows socially too.

Effect — Remove the Vaultborn Charisma flaw; gain no additional bonus in exchange — balance recovered, not created.

cinderfall.incomplete: Removing the Vaultborn ancestry's Charisma flaw (ancestries.vaultborn.json system.flaws.0) has no rule-element equivalent: ability boosts/flaws are resolved by Foundry's character-builder directly off the Ancestry item's own boosts/flaws fields at creation time, not via system.rules, and no real pf2e heritage adjusts them through a rule element either (0 hits for anything like AdjustAncestryBoosts in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/heritages).
